_schema.exemplar_format: COMPACT Option A (dispatcher ruling 2026-06-11): ~200 tok each, rendered as a labeled ABRIDGED teaching block — NOT a full verdict_json dump. Only the four teaching fields are rendered.

exemplar_fields.title: label string, must signal 'EXAMPLE -- do not copy'
exemplar_fields.verdict_json: the four COMPACT teaching fields (a nested object, OR may sit at the exemplar top level): winner_index 0|1, winner_reason (<20 words, with a number), key_tradeoff (one sentence), value_context {product_0, product_1}. Loader renders winner_index as 'Product N' (1-based) + Why/Tradeoff/Value lines. best_for / pros / cons / specs_comparison / personalized_insights are NOT part of the compact exemplar.
exemplar_fields._provenance: source-pattern id (e.g. supp-013) — INTERNAL ONLY, never rendered into the prompt

anti_patterns.name: identical on paper = identical in Bahrain
anti_patterns.rule: When two devices match on the spec sheet, the tie can still break on what a Bahrain owner lives with -- local after-sales service, spare-part and consumable availability, and update-support horizon.

anti_patterns.name: newer spec sheet beats canonical benchmark
anti_patterns.rule: A newer model number does not automatically beat the established gold-standard; weigh proven reliability and a longer ownership track record against a marginally fresher datasheet.

anti_patterns.name: climate-neutral verdict in a 45-degree market
anti_patterns.rule: For appliances (AC/cooling/fridges), grade real Gulf-summer load -- sustained performance and energy cost in 45-degree heat -- not just rated figures measured in mild conditions.

anti_patterns.name: score margin cited as the why
anti_patterns.rule: Never justify the winner by the size of its win or any internal score gap; name the concrete capability, price reality, or local advantage that makes it the better buy for a Bahrain shopper.

anti_patterns.name: global prestige outranks GCC market reality
anti_patterns.rule: A globally famous brand is not automatically the better pick here; a regional staple with broad local adoption and everyday availability can be the smarter everyday buy.
